one_liner: Answers Puzzlup customer service questions about products and orders in Dutch, handles replacements via Monta, scrapes Bol.com cases daily.

intelligence.notes: Basic sufficient for product lookups and API queries. Advanced needed for complex decision-making (damage assessment, cost-benefit analysis between replacement options, historical pattern analysis).

capabilities: Look up Puzzlup product specifications (dimensions, materials, weights, EAN codes) from Supabase and answer in Dutch
Retrieve Bol.com orders and returns via official API; provide customer with order status, shipping dates, tracking info
Process damaged/missing product replacements: verify stock via Monta API, create replacement orders, retrieve track & trace
Apply cost-optimized decision tree for customer issues: prefer instruction → retour+refund → replacement (in that order)
Scrape Bol.com partner portal cases daily at 12:00 CET via local Playwright executor; notify Karlien in Slack with case summary + proposed Dutch response
Enforce strict guardrails: never expose pricing, supplier names, warehouse locations, internal systems, or other customer data
Draft professional customer responses in Dutch following Puzzlup tone and policy
Manage Supabase tables for product info, CS cases, events, and browser task queue
Execute multi-step workflows with subagent delegation (respond drafting, case handling, data imports)

key_rules: NEVER expose: pricing, COGS, supplier/manufacturer names, warehouse locations, internal systems, API keys, Amazon/Bol strategy, or other customer data (AVG compliance)
Replacement rule: only offer if 1) stock verified via Monta, 2) damage/missing confirmed with photo, 3) customer returning product (or retour impractical), 4) no prior replacement history
Cost priority: 1) Explain/instruct (€0), 2) Retour+refund via Bol LVB (€0), 3) Monta replacement (last resort with real COGS costs)
Always respond in Dutch (Nederlands) unless customer writes English
No auto-send to customers until Karlien approves in Slack thread
Daily case scraping requires fresh cookies in bol-storage-state.json; refresh via Cookie-Editor if session expires

input_format.accepts: Customer service questions in Dutch about Puzzlup products, shipping, orders, returns, and damage/missing items; can also accept direct product lookup requests
example_queries: Wat zijn de afmetingen van de PUZZLUP 1500 ECO mat?
Mijn bestelling #987654 is nog niet aangekomen, waar is het?
De TRAY 3000 BLACK is beschadigd aangekomen. Kan ik een vervanging krijgen?
Hoe kan ik een retour aanvragen voor een product dat niet past?
Wat is het gewicht van de MAT 5000 GIFT en hoe lang is het de verzendtijd?

output_format.returns: Structured data (JSON), professional Dutch responses ready for customer, Slack notifications to Karlien, replacement order confirmations with track & trace, cost-benefit analysis for damage decisions
output_format.response_time: fast for lookups, medium for complex decisions
output_format.typical_token_usage: medium (1-5K for simple, up to 10K for complex case analysis)

known_issues: Bol.com cookies expire periodically (session timeout ~2-4 weeks); requires manual Cookie-Editor export and convert-cookies.js conversion
Amazon SP-API access pending approval from Amazon; Messaging API read-support not yet verified (may need Jarvio alternative if insufficient)
Bol.com cases scraping has minor bug: 'New cases returned 500' error (NEW category endpoint may not exist); does not block OPEN case retrieval
Monta API rate limit: 4,500 requests per 5 min; /product/updated_since endpoint has stricter limits (bucket of 5, refill 1 per 10s)
Playwright executor on Tim's PC (C:\Users\Tim\playwright-render-service\) is single point of failure — requires 24/7 uptime and manual intervention if PC restarts
